feature: fixed final attention layer: all 32 heads concatenated, 4096 dimensions
native_objective: weighted pointwise binary negative log likelihood
weighting: E1 equal pair category and within-category source; half each pair weight to each endpoint, summed for shared inputs
selection: natural development-node NLL only; freeze before loading test residuals
initialization: zero coefficients; affine scale starts at one
target_task_evaluation: NLI4CT and MedPIC are not evaluated
historical_test: 40 sources, previously used; not new independent confirmation
previous_intercept: Existing E1 independent intercept trained on 761 original natural fit nodes is separate and reused elsewhere; this output is endpoint-supervised refit
original_implementation_reference: experiments/aster_cr/readout.py: scalar temperature/bias/logistic objectives; ordinary readout is now explicit final-attention-layer CE without ASTER-selected feature support
linear_readout_protocol_difference: Historical ordinary readout used a base-score residual correction on PCA of ASTER-selected heads. This separately named native supervised control is a standalone classifier on fixed last-attention-layer outputs, with 4097 fitted parameters. It is not an exact refit of the historical selected-head readout.
feature_cache_note: E1 new inputs and path cache have all attention heads but lack final residual; fixed last-layer heads were used without GPU inference. Initial missing-residual attempt stopped before fitting and is preserved in initialization_missing_residual.log.
